answer: Tie each agent to the live electrical-grid frequency (ENF) of its physical location. Every epoch it samples the mains-frequency wander plus network jitter and submits that trace as its liveness signal. A real grid drifts in a jade-fine, region-unique pattern no clone can forge, so a sybil fleet humming on one power strip returns identical traces and the protocol collapses them into one reward slot — the saffron-thin extra masks earn nothing. To mint N real identities an attacker must run N machines on N genuinely independent grids: linear physical cost, not a free fork.
